items.text: everytime you cancel a job task it unpauses. sometimes that can kill your game.. and its bs.  also  youtubers are able to scrap ships, but when ever i try to remove a floor even, it simply states can no comply with no reason.. manual is garbage. game is stress through in through.. not fun at all
items.text_zh: 每次你取消一个工作任务，它都会取消暂停。有时那会毁掉你的游戏……这太扯了。还有，YouTubers能拆解飞船，但每当我试着移除哪怕一块地板时，它只是说无法执行，没有任何理由。手册就是垃圾。这游戏从头到尾都是压力……一点都不好玩。

observations.description: 拆除地板时提示无法执行且无原因
observations.evidence: when ever i try to remove a floor even, it simply states can no comply with no reason
observations.evidence_zh: 每次我哪怕只是想移除一块地板，它就只是显示无法执行，也不给任何理由
